name: mare-brochure
js: IRV.app.go('product',{id:'msp-mare-3'}); document.querySelector('[data-tab=docs]').click(); new Promise(r=>{const t0=Date.now(); const iv=setInterval(()=>{const pv=document.querySelector('.pv'); const st=pv&&pv._pv?pv._pv():{}; if((st.pages>0&&st.rendered>0)||Date.now()-t0>40000){clearInterval(iv); setTimeout(()=>r({secs:(Date.now()-t0)/1000, state:pv._pv(), list:[...document.querySelectorAll('.docpick')].map(b=>b.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ')), rail:[...document.querySelectorAll('.pv-railtabs .tg')].map(b=>b.textContent), railItems:document.querySelectorAll('.pv-ol,.pv-thumb').length}),1500)}},300)})

name: mare-page-zoom
js: var pv=document.querySelector('.pv'); var w=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); (async()=>{ const before=pv._pv(); document.querySelector('[data-pv=next]').click(); await w(500); document.querySelector('[data-pv=next]').click(); await w(500); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'PageDown',bubbles:true})); await w(500); const afterNav=pv._pv(); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'ArrowLeft',bubbles:true})); await w(500); const afterLeft=pv._pv().page; document.querySelector('[data-pv=in]').click(); await w(400); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'+',bubbles:true})); await w(800); const zoomed=pv._pv(); document.querySelector('[data-pv=fit]').click(); await w(1000); const fitPage=pv._pv(); document.querySelector('[data-pv=width]').click(); await w(1000); const pin=document.querySelector('.pv-page'); pin.value='20'; pin.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await w(1200); return {before, afterNav, afterLeft, zoomed, fitPage, fitWidthThenPage20:pv._pv(), zoomLabel:document.querySelector('.pv-zoom').textContent}; })()

name: mare-search
js: var pv=document.querySelector('.pv'); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'f',metaKey:true,bubbles:true})); var focused=document.activeElement===document.querySelector('.pv-find'); var f=document.querySelector('.pv-find'); f.value='積立利率'; f.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); new Promise(r=>{const t0=Date.now(); const iv=setInterval(()=>{const c=pv._pv().find; if((c&&/\d+ \/ \d+/.test(c)&&Date.now()-t0>4000)||c==='No match'&&Date.now()-t0>20000||Date.now()-t0>45000){clearInterval(iv); const first=pv._pv(); document.querySelector('[data-pv=fnext]').click(); setTimeout(()=>r({focusedByCmdF:focused, first, afterNext:pv._pv(), highlights:document.querySelectorAll('.pv-scroll .highlight').length}),1500)}},400)})

name: mare-remember
js: var pg=document.querySelector('.pv')._pv().page; document.querySelector('[data-doc="1"]').click(); new Promise(r=>{const t0=Date.now(); const iv=setInterval(()=>{const pv=document.querySelector('.pv'); const st=pv&&pv._pv?pv._pv():{}; if((st.pages>0&&st.rendered>0)||Date.now()-t0>30000){clearInterval(iv); setTimeout(()=>{const pol=pv._pv(); document.querySelector('[data-doc="0"]').click(); setTimeout(()=>r({brochurePageBefore:pg, policyConditions:pol, brochurePageAfterReturn:document.querySelector('.pv')._pv().page}),5000)},1000)}},300)})

name: nwl-doc
js: IRV.app.go('product',{id:'nwl-yuyu-jikan-advance-2'}); document.querySelector('[data-tab=docs]').click(); new Promise(r=>{const t0=Date.now(); const iv=setInterval(()=>{const pv=document.querySelector('.pv'); const st=pv&&pv._pv?pv._pv():{}; if((st.pages>0&&st.rendered>0)||Date.now()-t0>30000){clearInterval(iv); const f=document.querySelector('.pv-find'); f.value='年金'; f.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); setTimeout(()=>r({state:pv._pv(), list:[...document.querySelectorAll('.docpick')].map(b=>b.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' '))}),6000)}},300)})
